Eric Ding, CFA
CEO and Principal Portfolio Manager

Eric is the Founder and sole owner/operator of Twin Cape. Over his near-decade-long career, Eric has held stints at #1-ranked firms in two continents across every investable asset class. Eric brings experience across all of Equities, FICC, Real Estate, Private Equity, and Multi-Asset Portfolio Management. Eric holds a BCom/BA dual degree in Business and Computer Science from Queen's University. Eric is also an amateur pianist and an avid ice hockey fan.
